claims.explanation: Penfluridol's selectivity is best explained by its recently identified direct inhibition of PFKL, the liver-type phosphofructokinase, combined with its calcium-channel/calmodulin antagonism; lines that depend on high glycolytic flux and express PFKL (and related glycolytic machinery) are sensitized, while lines with low PFKL/glycolytic dependence or with protective NRF2/KEAP1-pathway or mesenchymal/ARID1A-driven states are spared. The transcriptional signature (HMOX1, GLRX, PMAIP1 up; proliferation genes down) supports oxidative-stress/apoptosis induction downstream of metabolic inhibition rather than a simple CACNA1G-mediated effect.

features.basis: PFKL is the direct penfluridol target; high expression required for drug activity (PMID 35530161)
KEAP1-mutant lines (LUDLU1) are among least affected; NRF2 activation buffers oxidative stress
NFE2L2-mutant squamous lines show mixed response; constitutive NRF2 antioxidant program may protect
ARID1A-mutant lines (MDAMB175VII, SW1088, FTC133, MHHNB11) are enriched among least affected
Annotated primary target T-type calcium channel; expression may mediate calcium-dependent effects
Penfluridol downregulates integrin alpha6 signaling; high integrin-dependent lines may be more sensitive (PMID 26627008)
Integrin beta4 axis is inhibited by penfluridol in TNBC models (PMID 26627008)
PTEN-mutant lines (UACC62, FTC133, KALS1) appear among least affected, possibly via PI3K/AKT survival signaling
TP53 mutation is near-universal in most-killed lines, consistent with impaired apoptosis checkpoints
KRAS-mutant lines (CL11, SNU410, GSU, LS1034, HS766T) are enriched among most-killed, consistent with glycolytic dependence
BRAF-mutant melanoma/thyroid lines (K029AX, 8305C) are among most-killed
SMARCA4-mutant lines (SKNSH, OV7) are among least affected
